prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.4% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) harms performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) harm performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-1.7% overall).
Evidence is thin or inconsistent for new home flows, adoption redesigns, and path selection redesigns, with no clear effect seen.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.7% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +0.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Choice Compact List Layout: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to a compact list layout with quick path comparison text. (why: Path selection stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis when choosing a pet adoption path.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Story Screen Mascot Welcome Intro: Insert a new introductory mascot welcome screen right before the story screen to set expectations. (why: First-run users spend mean 514s on the first step, suggesting a clearer initial context can help ground the onboarding experience.)
2: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Controls Overview: Redesign the home_intro screen using a two_column layout highlighting essential desktop controls for hiding, moving, and chatting with the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to pets after setup, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Spotlight Layout: Redesign the pick_friend selection screen using a spotlight layout to highlight individual pet traits one at a time. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long median duration (89s).)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Continuity Notice: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in preserves and restores account pets. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Visibility Tip: Add hint text on the waiting screen informing users that their pet will automatically drop onto their desktop tray once generated. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop after setup, and home waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s).)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Notification: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when background generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (nearly 39 minutes), indicating users minimize the app while waiting for pet creation.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact Overview Layout: Change the story screen layout to compact to present the pet app premise quickly without excessive scrolling. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, showing users get stuck early in the intro sequence.)
